actions.create_raindrop.description: Saves a new bookmark to your Raindrop.io account
actions.create_raindrop.props.collection: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).
actions.create_raindrop.props.excerpt.de: Short description or summary of the page
Mark this bookmark as important / favourite
actions.create_raindrop.props.link.descr: The URL of the page to bookmark
actions.create_raindrop.props.note.descr: Personal note to attach to this bookmark
actions.create_raindrop.props.tags.descr: List of tags to organize the bookmark (press Enter to add each tag)
actions.create_raindrop.props.title.desc: Custom title for the bookmark. If left empty, Raindrop will extract it from the URL automatically.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_raindrop.description: Moves a bookmark to the trash. To permanently delete it, empty the trash in Raindrop.io.
actions.delete_raindrop.props.raindrop_i: The numeric ID of the bookmark to delete. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).
actions.find_raindrops.description: Lists bookmarks from a collection, with optional keyword search
actions.find_raindrops.props.collection_: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).
actions.find_raindrops.props.limit.descr: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (max 50)
actions.find_raindrops.props.search.desc: Filter bookmarks by keyword. Supports operators like #tag or type:article. Leave empty to list all bookmarks.
actions.get_raindrop.description: Retrieves the details of a bookmark by its ID
actions.get_raindrop.props.raindrop_id.d: The numeric ID of the bookmark. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).
actions.raindrop_accept_invitation.descr: Joins a shared collection using an invitation token.
actions.raindrop_accept_invitation.props: ID of the collection you were invited to, from the invitation email.
Secret token from the invitation email link.
actions.raindrop_add_highlight.descripti: Adds a highlighted quote to a bookmark.
actions.raindrop_add_highlight.props.rai: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.
actions.raindrop_check_urls_exist.descri: Checks whether URLs are already saved as bookmarks.
actions.raindrop_create_backup.descripti: Starts generating a new backup of all bookmarks.
actions.raindrop_create_bookmark.descrip: Saves a new bookmark (raindrop) from a URL.
actions.raindrop_create_bookmark.props.c: Collection ID to save into, from List Collections. Defaults to Unsorted (-1).
actions.raindrop_create_bookmark.props.i: Mark the bookmark as a favourite.
actions.raindrop_create_bookmark.props.t: Bookmark title. Parsed from the page when omitted.
actions.raindrop_create_bookmarks.descri: Saves up to 100 bookmarks in one call.
JSON array of 1 to 100 bookmark objects, e.g. [{"link": "https://example.com", "title": "Example", "tags": ["ai"], "collection": {"$id": 123}}]. Missing title, excerpt and cover are parsed from the page.
actions.raindrop_create_collection.props: Cover image URLs, e.g. one from Search Covers or List Featured Covers.
ID of the parent collection, from List Collections or List Child Collections. Omit to create a root collection.
actions.raindrop_delete_bookmark.descrip: Moves a bookmark to Trash, or deletes it permanently if already in Trash.
actions.raindrop_delete_bookmark.props.r: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.
actions.raindrop_delete_bookmarks.descri: Moves many bookmarks in a collection to Trash at once.
Set to true to delete every bookmark in the collection. Required when neither Bookmark IDs nor Search is set.
Collection ID holding the bookmarks, from List Collections. -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash (permanent delete); 0 = all collections except Trash.
Only delete these bookmark IDs, from List Bookmarks.
Only delete bookmarks matching this Raindrop search query, e.g. "#old".
actions.raindrop_delete_collection.descr: Deletes a collection and all its sub-collections.
actions.raindrop_delete_collection.props: Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
actions.raindrop_delete_collections.prop: IDs of the collections to delete, from List Collections or List Child Collections, e.g. ["123", "456"].
actions.raindrop_delete_empty_collection: Deletes every collection that has no bookmarks.
actions.raindrop_delete_highlight.descri: Removes a highlight from a bookmark.
ID of the bookmark the highlight is on: raindropRef from List Highlights.
actions.raindrop_delete_tags.description: Removes tags from every bookmark that has them.
actions.raindrop_delete_tags.props.colle: Collection ID from List Collections to limit the removal to. Leave empty to remove from all collections.
Tag names to remove, exactly as returned by List Tags, e.g. ["old", "temp"].
actions.raindrop_download_backup.descrip: Downloads a backup as an HTML or CSV file.
actions.raindrop_download_backup.props.b: Backup ID from List Backups, e.g. "659d42a35ffbb2eb5ae1cb86".
actions.raindrop_empty_trash.description: Permanently deletes every bookmark in Trash.
actions.raindrop_expand_collections.prop: Yes expands all collections, No collapses all.
actions.raindrop_export_bookmarks.descri: Exports the bookmarks of a collection as a CSV, HTML or ZIP file.
Collection ID from List Collections. Defaults to 0 (all bookmarks); -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
Only export bookmarks matching this Raindrop search query, e.g. "#ai".
Sort order. Defaults to newest first (-created).
actions.raindrop_get_bookmark.descriptio: Gets a single bookmark by its ID.
actions.raindrop_get_bookmark.props.rain: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.
actions.raindrop_get_collection.descript: Gets a single collection by ID.
actions.raindrop_get_collection.props.co: Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
actions.raindrop_get_collection_counts.d: Gets bookmark counts for the system collections (All, Unsorted, Trash).
actions.raindrop_get_current_user.descri: Gets the profile and settings of the connected account.
actions.raindrop_get_filters.description: Gets tag, type, favourite, broken and duplicate counts for a collection.
actions.raindrop_get_filters.props.colle: Collection ID from List Collections. Defaults to 0 (all bookmarks).
actions.raindrop_get_filters.props.searc: Raindrop search query to count only matching bookmarks, e.g. "#reading" or "apple".
actions.raindrop_get_filters.props.tagsS: Order of the tags list. Defaults to count.
actions.raindrop_get_user_by_name.descri: Gets the public profile of a Raindrop.io user by username.
The Raindrop.io username, as shown in the user's public profile URL.
actions.raindrop_list_backups.descriptio: Lists the account backups, newest first.
actions.raindrop_list_bookmarks.descript: Lists bookmarks in a collection, with optional search and sort.
actions.raindrop_list_bookmarks.props.co: Collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. Defaults to 0 (all bookmarks except Trash); -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
actions.raindrop_list_bookmarks.props.ne: Yes also includes bookmarks from child collections. Defaults to No.
actions.raindrop_list_bookmarks.props.pe: Bookmarks per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 25.
actions.raindrop_list_bookmarks.props.se: Raindrop search query, the same text that works in the Raindrop app search box, e.g. "#ai type:article".
actions.raindrop_list_bookmarks.props.so: Sort order. Defaults to newest first (-created).
actions.raindrop_list_collaborators.desc: Lists the people a collection is shared with.
actions.raindrop_list_collaborators.prop: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.
actions.raindrop_list_featured_covers.de: Lists the featured cover icon sets.
actions.raindrop_list_highlights.descrip: Lists highlights across all bookmarks or in one collection.
actions.raindrop_list_highlights.props.c: Collection ID from List Collections to list highlights of. Leave empty for highlights in all collections.
actions.raindrop_list_highlights.props.p: Highlights per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 25.
actions.raindrop_list_tags.description: Lists tags with the number of bookmarks using each.
actions.raindrop_list_tags.props.collect: Collection ID from List Collections to list tags of. Leave empty for tags in all collections.
actions.raindrop_merge_collections.props: IDs of the collections to merge into the target, e.g. ["123", "456"].
ID of the collection to merge into, from List Collections or List Child Collections.
actions.raindrop_merge_tags.description: Merges several tags into one tag.
actions.raindrop_merge_tags.props.collec: Collection ID from List Collections to limit the merge to. Leave empty to merge in all collections.
actions.raindrop_merge_tags.props.newNam: Name of the tag they are merged into. Can be one of the listed tags or a new name.
actions.raindrop_merge_tags.props.tags.d: Tag names to merge, exactly as returned by List Tags, e.g. ["js", "javascript"].
actions.raindrop_parse_import_file.descr: Converts an HTML bookmarks export file into JSON folders and bookmarks.
actions.raindrop_parse_import_file.props: HTML bookmarks file in Netscape, Pocket or Instapaper export format.
actions.raindrop_parse_url.description: Extracts title, excerpt, media and type from any URL without saving it.
actions.raindrop_remove_collaborator.des: Removes a person from a shared collection.
actions.raindrop_remove_collaborator.pro: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.
Collaborator user ID, from List Collaborators.
actions.raindrop_rename_tag.description: Renames a tag on every bookmark that has it.
actions.raindrop_rename_tag.props.collec: Collection ID from List Collections to limit the rename to. Leave empty to rename in all collections.
actions.raindrop_rename_tag.props.tag.de: Current tag name, exactly as returned by List Tags.
actions.raindrop_share_collection.descri: Invites people by email to collaborate on a collection.
ID of the collection to share, from List Collections.
Email addresses to invite, 1 to 10 per call, e.g. ["someone@example.com"].
Access level: "member" can edit and invite more people, "viewer" is read-only.
actions.raindrop_sort_collections.descri: Reorders all collections by title or bookmark count.
Order to apply to all collections.
actions.raindrop_unshare_collection.desc: Stops sharing a collection you own, or leaves a collection shared with you.
actions.raindrop_unshare_collection.prop: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.descrip: Updates the fields you set on an existing bookmark.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.c: Remove all tags from the bookmark. Cannot be combined with Tags.
Collection ID to move the bookmark into, from List Collections. -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
New cover image URL. Use Upload Bookmark Cover to upload an image file instead.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.e: New short description of the page.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.i: Mark or unmark the bookmark as a favourite.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.o: Sort position in its collection, ascending; 0 moves it to the top.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.p: Re-read cover, type and content from the URL in the background.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.r: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.
actions.raindrop_update_bookmark.props.t: Tag names that replace the current tags, e.g. ["reading", "ai"].
actions.raindrop_update_bookmarks.descri: Updates many bookmarks in a collection at once.
Set to true to update every bookmark in the collection. Required when neither Bookmark IDs nor Search is set.
Remove all tags from the bookmarks. Cannot be combined with Tags.
Collection ID holding the bookmarks, from List Collections. -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash; 0 = all collections except Trash.
Cover image URL to set, or "<screenshot>" to use a page screenshot.
Only update these bookmark IDs, from List Bookmarks.
Mark or unmark the bookmarks as favourites.
Only update bookmarks matching this Raindrop search query, e.g. "#ai".
Tag names to add to the bookmarks, e.g. ["reading"]. Existing tags are kept.
Collection ID to move the bookmarks into, from List Collections.
actions.raindrop_update_collaborator.des: Changes a collaborator's access level on a shared collection.
actions.raindrop_update_collaborator.pro: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.
New access level: "member" can edit and invite more people, "viewer" is read-only.
Collaborator user ID, from List Collaborators.
actions.raindrop_update_collection.props: Yes removes the current cover. Cannot be combined with Cover URLs.
Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
Cover image URLs, e.g. one from Search Covers or List Featured Covers. Replaces the current cover.
Yes makes the collection a root collection. Cannot be combined with Parent Collection ID.
ID of the new parent collection, from List Collections or List Child Collections.
Make the collection and its bookmarks accessible without authentication.
How bookmarks in the collection are displayed.
actions.raindrop_update_highlight.descri: Changes the text or color of a highlight on a bookmark.
ID of the bookmark the highlight is on: raindropRef from List Highlights.
actions.raindrop_update_user.description: Updates the connected account's name, email, settings or collection groups.
actions.raindrop_update_user.props.confi: Settings keys to change, e.g. {"raindrops_sort": "-created", "raindrops_view": "grid", "lang": "en_US"}. Keys as returned in "config" by Get Current User.
actions.raindrop_update_user.props.group: Full list of sidebar groups, replacing the current one, e.g. [{"title": "My Collections", "hidden": false, "sort": 0, "collections": [8364483, 8364403]}]. Collection IDs from List Collections.
actions.raindrop_upload_bookmark_cover.d: Uploads an image as the cover of a bookmark.
actions.raindrop_upload_bookmark_cover.p: PNG, GIF or JPEG image file.
Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.
actions.raindrop_upload_collection_cover: Uploads an image file as the cover of a collection.
Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.
PNG, GIF or JPEG image file.
actions.raindrop_upload_file.description: Uploads a file and saves it as a new bookmark.
actions.update_raindrop.description: Updates the details of an existing bookmark
actions.update_raindrop.props.collection: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).
actions.update_raindrop.props.excerpt.de: Updated short description or summary of the page
Mark or unmark this bookmark as important / favourite
actions.update_raindrop.props.note.descr: Updated personal note attached to the bookmark
actions.update_raindrop.props.raindrop_i: The numeric ID of the bookmark to update. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).
actions.update_raindrop.props.tags.descr: New list of tags (replaces existing tags). Leave empty to keep existing tags unchanged.
description: Bookmark manager to save, search, and organize content from the web
